title: VideoTree: Adaptive Tree-based Video Representation for LLM Reasoning on Long Videos
selection_reason: VideoTree builds a training-free, query-adaptive hierarchy of long-video frames for LLM reasoning, targeting redundant video context at inference; it is a concrete inference-time representation method.
